arrivee_lac.title: The Lake
arrivee_lac.text:
You arrive at the edge of a big lake.

The water is calm and clear.

Aikito is beside you.
He is wearing a diving mask and a snorkel.
He had them in his bag from the start.

**"How did you know?"** you ask.

He shrugs.

**"I had a feeling."**

You look into the water.

Far below,
you see rooftops.
Streets.
Gardens.

Your old town.

regarder_surface.title: From the Surface
regarder_surface.text:
You lie on your stomach at the edge of the lake.

You look.

You recognize the main street.
The church steeple.
The big tree in the square.

They are still there.
Just... below.

Aikito lies down beside you.

His snorkel sticks out of the water.

**"Do you want to go?"**

You nod.

**"Then let's go."**

premiere_rue.title: Main Street
premiere_rue.text:
Underwater, it feels strange.

Everything is silent.
But not empty.

The baker takes bread out of the oven.
Bubbles rise toward the top.

The mail carrier pedals his bicycle.
His hair floats in every direction.

Children play hopscotch on the sidewalk.
Their laughter makes little circles in the water.

No one seems to find it odd.

Aikito swims beside you.

**"They kept going."** he says.
**"That's all."**

boulangere.title: The Baker
boulangere.text:
The baker smiles at you.

As if you had left only yesterday.

She hands you a croissant.

It is soggy.
But she looks so proud.

**"It takes a long time underwater."** she says.
**"The dough keeps floating away."**

She laughs.

**"But we adapted."**

You look at the shop window.
The pastries float gently behind the glass.

**"Do you remember my apple tart?"** she asks.

You nod.

You remember it very well.

enfants_marelle.title: Hopscotch
enfants_marelle.text:
The children jump on the hopscotch grid.

With each jump, their feet leave the ground a second too long.

They float a little.

Then land softly.

One of them sees you.

**"Want to play?"**

You look at the hopscotch grid.
The squares are the same as before.

Aikito is already sitting on square 5.
He is pretending nothing is happening.

**"Aikito..."**

**"What?"**

jouer_marelle.title: The Jump
jouer_marelle.text:
You jump.

On square 3, your feet leave the ground.

You float for a second.

It is strange.
It is gentle.

The children laugh.

**"It's better underwater!"** one says.
**"We jump higher."**

Aikito watches you from square 5.

**"You see."** he says.
**"Different."**
**"Not worse."**
**"Just different."**

chercher_maison.title: Your House
chercher_maison.text:
You find your old house at the end of the street.

It is there.

The blue door.
The rose bush against the wall.
The green shutters.

Everything is there.

But someone else lives there now.

A family.
The children have hung drawings in the windows.
The drawings float gently.

You stop in front of the door.

devant_maison.title: In Front of the Door
devant_maison.location: Underwater — In front of your house
devant_maison.text:
You stay there.

You look at the blue door.

It is the same color.
Exactly the same.

Aikito sits beside you.

He says nothing.

He waits.

After a while, you say:

**"It is still there."**

**"Yes."** says Aikito.

**"And I remember it too."**

**"That's what matters."** says Aikito.

nouvelle_famille.title: The New Family
nouvelle_famille.text:
The door opens.

A woman smiles at you.

**"Hello!"**

**"I used to live here."** you say.

She opens the door wide.

**"Come in!"**

Inside, it is different.
Different furniture.
Different colors.
Different smells.

But the big living-room window is in the same place.
With the same light coming through.

**"It's a beautiful house."** says the woman.

**"Yes."** you answer.

And you really mean it.

remonter.title: Rising Up
remonter.text:
You rise slowly.

The town moves away below you.

You see the rooftops.
The steeple.
The big tree.

The baker steps out of her shop.
She waves at you.

The hopscotch children look up.
One of them waves.

Aikito swims beside you.

**"Will you come back?"** you ask.

**"If you want."** he says.
**"Memories are always there."**
**"You just have to dive."**

fin_surface.title: End — The Surface
fin_surface.text:
You lift your head out of the water.

The sun.
The air.
The sound of birds.

You lie on the grass by the lake.

You look at the sky.

Aikito takes off his mask.
He shakes himself dry.

**"So?"**

You think.

**"It is still there."** you say.
**"Just... underneath."**

Aikito lies down beside you.

**"The places we love stay."**
**"In the water."**
**"In our heads."**
**"It's the same."**

You look at the lake.

The water is calm.
And below, life goes on.

fin_rester.title: End — A Little Longer
fin_rester.text:
You go back down.

The baker is waiting with another croissant.
Soggy.
But warm.

The children start hopscotch again.

The town goes on.

You sit on the bench in the square.
The same bench as before.

Aikito settles beside you.

You watch the town move.

Bubbles rise.
Shutters open and close.
The mail carrier passes by.

**"Can we stay a little longer?"** you ask.

**"As long as we want."** says Aikito.

Memories have all the time in the world.

fin_au_revoir.title: End — Goodbye
fin_au_revoir.text:
Before going back up,
you return to your house.

You place your hand on the blue door.

It is cold.
And soft.

**"Goodbye."** you whisper.

The door does not answer.

But something in your chest
settles gently.

Like a stone you set down.
Not one you throw.
One you place.

Aikito looks at you.

**"Are you okay?"**

**"Yes."** you answer.

And it is true.
